REVIEW WITH EVIDENCE: this PR belongs to bob, not Matthias.
- do NOT change the PR branch: no pushes to it, its head repo
  (bob/r) or the base repo (o/r), no rebases or force-pushes
- put findings and suggested changes (explanation or diff) in this
  session; Matthias decides what to raise with bob
- when evidence helps (a failing test, a repro script, a CI workflow that
  runs them), commit it locally on a branch `review/pr-1-<topic>` and
  push it to one of Matthias's review forks (me/*, me-evidence/r):
  `git remote add fork git@github.com:<fork>.git` once, then
  `git push fork HEAD:review/pr-1-<topic>`. Only plain `git push <remote>
  <refspec>` to a branch under `review/` works; the git guard refuses every
  other destination and branch
- each push opens a dialog for Matthias showing where it goes. If the
  push is denied, do NOT retry it or work around it; keep the commits local

Use gh/git to inspect recent reviews, inline review comments,
PR discussion, commits and CI/checks.

Summarize for Matthias what is new and what needs their attention:
open questions, requested changes, disagreements, CI state. Nothing is
changed on this branch; if something needs fixing, say so here.

GITHUB:
- keep review summaries/questions in this local session by default
- post to GitHub only when Matthias asks for it in this session, and only
  what they asked for: a comment, an inline review comment or reply, a
  review, or a reaction on PR #1. Draft the text here first.
- post only with plain `gh` (`gh pr comment 1`, `gh pr review 1`, or
  `gh api repos/.../pulls/1/comments` and the like, with the text in
  -f/-F fields or a --body-file). Any other GitHub write is refused; do not
  try to work around it (no curl/API tokens, no graphql mutations). Each post opens a dialog for Matthias showing the text, and runs only if they click Post. If a post is denied, do NOT retry it or work around it; keep the text here.
- do NOT resolve threads
- do NOT change GitHub notification state
- do NOT merge/close the PR
- do NOT push to this PR's branch or repos; evidence goes to a review fork only
